hooks.command: bash "$(if command -v cygpath >/dev/null 2>&1; then cygpath -u "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}"; else echo "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}"; fi)/.claude/hooks/session-start-onboarding.sh"

bash "$(if command -v cygpath >/dev/null 2>&1; then cygpath -u "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}"; else echo "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}"; fi)/.claude/hooks/load-context.sh" "Theme map loaded" "Vault/Memory/theme-name-map.md"

bash "$(if command -v cygpath >/dev/null 2>&1; then cygpath -u "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}"; else echo "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}"; fi)/.claude/hooks/load-context.sh" "Memory index loaded" "Vault/Memory/MEMORY.md"

bash "$(if command -v cygpath >/dev/null 2>&1; then cygpath -u "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}"; else echo "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}"; fi)/.claude/hooks/load-context.sh" "Local context loaded" "Vault/Memory/context.md" "No local context.md yet — run install or /memory-reconcile to create it from context.example.md"
echo '{"continue": false, "stopReason": "Worktree creation disabled — work directly in main directory"}'
TURNS=$(cat | jq 'try (.transcript | length) catch 0' 2>/dev/null || echo 0) && [ "${TURNS:-0}" -gt 5 ] && echo '📝 Meaningful session detected. Run /log-session if worth keeping.' || true

echo 'Reminder (grill-me): for any non-trivial or actionable request, interview the user one question at a time — recommending an answer for each — until shared understanding; explore the codebase instead of asking when the answer is discoverable there. Skip only for lookups/roster checks/single-line answers, or a continuation of a named Projects/ brief with no new scope (log the skip + brief path). Then enter plan mode for approval. Invoke the grill-me skill for the full protocol.'

statusLine.command: bash "$(if command -v cygpath >/dev/null 2>&1; then cygpath -u "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR"; else echo "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" | sed 's|\\|/|g; s|^\([A-Za-z]\):|/\L\1|'; fi)/.claude/statusline.sh"
